name: Automated Test Reviewer
feedback: Exceptional UI design and smooth UX. Works perfectly.

name: Dr. A. Deshmukh
feedback: An exemplary community initiative. Having verified contact numbers and operating hours of local public health centers saves crucial minutes during emergencies.
suggestion: Consider adding blood bank availability indicators in future phases.

name: Meera Nair
feedback: The interactive map is fast and very easy to navigate on mobile. Wheelchair accessibility tags are especially helpful for my grandparents.
suggestion: Add Marathi language translation in the future if possible.

name: Vikram Mehta
feedback: Clean, clutter-free design. Far better than outdated government portal listings. Proud to see Mumbai University students building practical civic tools.
suggestion: Keep updating the public toilet hygiene indicators.
